en: Chapter Two
The Lord's Table
The Lord's Table
The lord of Daylight City has invited you to eat. Take a seat
zh_TW: 白晝城的城主請你們吃飯。去桌邊坐下

en: Ask Isa where Misha's brother is
zh_TW: 問伊薩，彌夏的弟弟在哪裡

en: Isa
(No poison. No ambush. Three plates of boiled beans, a pot of thin porridge, and four bowls — each one chipped in a different place.)
zh_TW: （沒有毒。沒有埋伏。三盤煮豆，一鍋稀粥，和四個缺口不一樣的碗。）

en: (The lord's name was Isa — a middle-aged man who hadn't shaved very well. When he pulled out our chairs, the metal brace on his right leg creaked.)
zh_TW: （城主名叫伊薩，是個鬍子刮得不乾淨的中年人。他替我們拉椅子時，右腿的金屬支架吱了一聲。）

en: Your hand — there's a very good doctor in the city. I'll ask her to come by.
zh_TW: 妳的手——城裡有位很好的醫師，我請她過來看看。

en: And you're the clockmaker looking for her brother. Have you found him?
zh_TW: 妳是來找弟弟的那位鐘匠吧。找到他了嗎？

en: Not yet.
The bell yard's shift runs until midnight today. You can wait for him here.
zh_TW: 鐘院的輪值今天到午夜。妳可以在這裡等他。

en: Why did he go into the bell yard?
(Isa didn't answer right away.)
(Misha put down her spoon.)
The Year-Eating Usurper
Weak point: the heart
Hold {key} — see through Isa
Follow Isa into the inner room of the bell yard
zh_TW: 跟著伊薩走進鐘院內室

en: He volunteered.
Then let him out. Right now.
I can't.
The bell… that was me. I'm sorry.
zh_TW: 鐘的事……是我做的。對不起。

en: (Say nothing.)
The bell… that was me. I'm sorry.
zh_TW: 鐘的事……是我做的。對不起。

en: …Eat first. The soup is getting cold.
(I looked at the beans and said nothing.)
zh_TW: （我看著那盤豆子，什麼都沒說。）

en: (The soup on the table slowly went cold.)
Come with me. You should see him.
